name: Runner Extras - TestPage Lookup TableRelation Served
brief: Issue #3518: a TestPage lookup whose only source is a TableRelation opens the related table's LookupPageId page through BC's own lookup-mode RunModal, so a declared [ModalPageHandler] serves it; a field with no relation at all does nothing (BC's measured behaviour), while a relation to a table with no lookup page still refuses by name.
description: Runner-specific claim about the runner's DISPATCH, not about AL. That real BC opens the related table's lookup page and writes the selection back is proven upstream in the al-language corpus (TRL Tests, codeunit 60569) against a real service tier. What is asserted here is which of the runner's paths a given shape takes. Of the two shapes with nothing to open, only one is a runner boundary: corpus run 35445556865 measured on all eight cloud legs that BC raises nothing for a field with no TableRelation at all, so the runner must not either; a relation whose target table declares no lookup page is still refused by name, because no corpus test has measured what BC's client does there.
